metadata.description: McBrain — a persistent, LLM-maintained personal knowledge base built on Karpathy's LLM Wiki pattern.

plugins.name: mcbrain
plugins.description: Build and operate McBrain — a personal LLM-maintained knowledge base in Obsidian. Bundles cooperating skills for one-shot vault setup, day-to-day operations (ingest/query/lint/synth), and a local research tracker that drains queued tasks and writes findings back into the vault.
